claim: The sample workspace is separate from real files and labels.
sandbox: Start at /demo, reset the populated sample, create real local work, then return from demo and confirm the real work remains.

claim: Opens local images and PDFs up to 50 MB.
sandbox: From /demo, open PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF, and PDF files; accept an exact 50 MiB WebP, reject 50 MiB plus one byte, then recover with a PNG.

claim: Samples a five-pixel area and shows a readable hex value.
sandbox: From /demo, mark a known status cue and assert a six-digit hex value is shown.

claim: Saves labels with six distinct textures and numbered callouts.
sandbox: From /demo, save one label with each texture and assert all labels and their numbered callouts appear.

claim: Lets you edit, move, delete, and undo saved labels.
sandbox: From /demo, edit a sample label, nudge it by keyboard, delete it, and restore it with Undo.
From /demo, export a workspace and compare its embedded source bytes with the shipped sample.
From /demo, export the populated canvas and assert a PNG download signature and annotated filename.

claim: Exports and restores a JSON workspace.
sandbox: From /demo under the production connect-src policy, export a labeled workspace, remove it, import it, and assert the label returns.

claim: Keeps saved work in this browser after a reload.
sandbox: From /demo, save a label, reload, and assert it remains visible.
From /demo, assert the manifest has standalone display and icons and that a service worker controls the page.

claim: Works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: Fresh browser context at /demo, wait for service-worker control, go offline, reload, and assert the populated sample remains usable.

claim: Shows an update action when a fresh app version is ready.
sandbox: From /demo, trigger the service-worker update event and assert the reload action is visible.

claim: Supports theme choice, mobile layout, and keyboard labeling.
sandbox: From /demo at 390 px, change the theme and create a label with keyboard marking; assert no horizontal page overflow.

claim: Uses no accounts, analytics, or tracking.
sandbox: Record every request during a sample labeling flow and assert every origin is the product origin.

claim: Uses no remote fonts, third-party scripts, CDN, or external API.
sandbox: Record every request during a sample export and assert every origin is the product origin.

claim: Does not upload opened files or labels.
sandbox: Record every request while opening and labeling a local file from /demo and assert all are same-origin GET requests.

claim: The utility is free and needs no account or payment.
sandbox: Assert the landing and Terms pages state the free, no-account, no-payment offering.
